headline: Earnings surge on higher prices despite lower production
summary_short: ConocoPhillips reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $19.16B (+36.8% y/y, +21.6% q/q) and diluted EPS of $3.23, up 107.1% y/y and 81.5% q/q, as total realized price rose 36% to $62.33/BOE even though production fell to 2,248 MBOED.
summary_long: Revenue of $19.16B rose 36.8% y/y on a 36% jump in realized price to $62.33/BOE, offsetting a production decline to 2,248 MBOED (-143 MBOED y/y) driven by the Middle East conflict's impact on Qatar and higher Surmont royalties, partly offset by Lower 48 organic growth. Net income of $3.93B (+99.4% y/y) and diluted EPS of $3.23 (+107.1% y/y) reflect the price gain; adjusted EPS was $3.24 excluding a $274M asset-sale gain and other special items. Cash and cash equivalents rose to $6.57B. The company doubled buybacks to $2.0B, paid $1.0B in dividends, hit its $5B disposition target early, reaffirmed full-year guidance, and guided Q3 production to 2.29-2.32 MMBOED.

drivers.explanation: Earnings and adjusted earnings increased primarily due to higher prices; total realized price of $62.33/BOE was 36% above $45.77/BOE a year ago.
Organic Lower 48 growth was more than offset by the Middle East conflict's impact on Qatar output and higher Surmont royalties; portfolio-adjusted production fell 4% y/y.
Higher realized prices drove the earnings increase; adjusted earnings exclude a $274M asset-sale gain, transaction/restructuring costs, an interest-rate hedge gain, and pending-claims charges.
Total average realized price rose to $62.33/BOE from $45.77/BOE a year ago, a 36% increase that the company states as the primary driver of the earnings improvement.

Company highlights record Permian production, doubled buybacks, an early $5B disposition-target close, a new Iraq JV, LNG offtake growth to 12 MTPA, and reaffirmed full-year guidance while guiding Q3 production to 2.29-2.32 MMBOED.
